refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.intro: We strive to deliver every order accurately and within the promised delivery timeframe. However, if an order cannot be delivered for any reason, or is cancelled where applicable, the following refund policy will apply.

cancellation.title: 1. Order Cancellation & Refund
body: For prepaid orders, if an order is cancelled before delivery, the amount paid by the customer will be refunded, subject to eligibility.
If we are unable to fulfill an order for any reason, or fail to deliver the order within the promised timeframe, the amount paid by the customer will be processed for a refund.

afterDelivery.title: 2. Cancellation/Return After Delivery
body: Once a book has been delivered, a refund will generally not be applicable solely due to a change of mind or personal preference.

However, if the customer receives a wrong book, damaged book, torn book, missing pages, or any other product defect, the customer may notify us within the applicable period. After verification, we may provide a replacement or refund, as appropriate.

method.title: 3. Refund Method
body: Refunds will generally be made through the same payment method used by the customer to make the payment, including bKash, Nagad, Rocket, card, bank transfer, or other applicable payment methods.

processingTime.title: 4. Refund Processing Time
body: Once a refund has been approved, it may generally take 7–10 business days to process. Any additional processing time required by the relevant bank, mobile financial service provider, payment gateway, or other payment service provider will be outside this timeframe.

deliveryCharge.title: 5. Delivery & Return Charges
body: If an order has already entered the delivery process and is cancelled at the customer's request, refused at delivery, or returned, applicable delivery and/or return costs may be deducted from the refundable amount, where applicable.

specialCases.title: 6. Special Circumstances
body: Each refund request will be reviewed based on the order status, payment information, and reason for the refund. We may request additional information or evidence where necessary to verify the claim.

refundPolicy.note: Refund eligibility and the refundable amount may vary depending on the type of order, delivery status, and reason for the refund.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains what we collect when you place an order, and how it is used.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
body: When you place an order, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, delivery address, order details, and any delivery notes you provide.
For manual payments, we may also collect your payment method, mobile-money sender number, and transaction ID.

use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
body: We use this information only to process and deliver your orders, verify payments, contact you regarding your order, process cancellations, returns and refunds, provide customer support, maintain necessary transaction and accounting records, and prevent fraud and comply with applicable laws.
We do not sell, rent, or use your personal information for marketing or promotional purposes.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing Your Information
body: We may share necessary delivery information, such as your name, phone number and address, with our courier/delivery partners.
Payment information may be accessed by authorized personnel for payment verification. We do not share your information for unrelated advertising or marketing.

payment.title: 4. Payment Information
body: Mobile-money payment details, including transaction IDs and sender numbers, are used only for payment verification, order processing, refunds and dispute resolution. We do not collect or store card details through our current payment process.

retention.title: 5. Data Retention & Deletion
body: We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary for order support, payment verification, refunds, accounting, dispute resolution and legal requirements.
You may contact us to request correction or deletion of your personal information, subject to applicable legal or business requirements.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies & Tracking
body: We currently do not use advertising pixels or analytics tools to track users. Essential cookies may be used for the basic operation and security of the website.

security.title: 7. Data Security
body: We take reasonable measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, misuse, loss or disclosure.

updates.title: 8. Policy Updates
body: We may update this Privacy Policy when our services, practices or applicable legal requirements change. The updated version will be published on this page.

privacyPolicy.note: For privacy-related questions or requests, please contact us using the details in the footer below.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By browsing this site or placing an order, you agree to the following terms.

orders.title: 1. Orders & Availability
body: Placing an order is a request to buy, not a guaranteed sale — we may cancel or adjust an order for stock, pricing, or address issues and will let you know. Listed books are subject to availability; a sold-out title is removed rather than back-ordered.

payment.title: 2. Pricing & Payment
body: Prices are shown in BDT and may change without notice. For cash on delivery, payment is due to the courier; for bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or bank transfer, an order is confirmed only once payment is verified.

delivery.title: 3. Delivery
body: Delivery timeframes are estimates, not guarantees, and depend on your address and the courier. Please double-check your shipping details — we are not responsible for delays caused by an incomplete or incorrect address.

refunds.title: 4. Cancellations & Refunds
body: Cancellations, returns, and refunds are handled under our Refund Policy.

conduct.title: 5. Fair Use
body: Please order in good faith. We reserve the right to cancel repeated or fraudulent orders, including habitual refusal of cash-on-delivery parcels.

liability.title: 6. Liability
body: We are not liable for delays or losses caused by circumstances outside our control, including courier or payment provider outages.

changes.title: 7. Changes to These Terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time; the version on this page is the one that applies.

terms.note: Questions about these terms? Reach us at info@nihonovaacademy.com.
